business_process: Part 37 security monitoring and access control
description: Vault IDS monitoring, badge access, video assessment, and alarm response for the category 2 security zone
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 37.41(b) requires monitoring and detection without delay; 37.49(a)(1) requires capability on loss of power or an alarm and response; loss of badge control or video beyond 4 hours cannot be covered by staff alone for long. RPO is for PACS configuration and event logs
manual_workaround: IDS runs independently with battery and cellular path; approved individuals keep direct control of the vault (37.47(c)(2)); no source receipt or shipment until restored
dependent_systems: SYS-10 (PACS server; NVR; IDS communicator); SYS-07 (today)
dependent_third_parties: Alarm monitoring company; security system vendor; county sheriff (LLEA)

description: Area radiation monitors, vehicle portal monitor, stack effluent monitor, surveys, and dosimetry records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Effluent and area monitoring records must be continuous under the license (Chapter 64E-5); portal monitor gates every inbound truck
manual_workaround: Portable survey instruments; manual stack sampler readings every 4 hours; stop processing that can release airborne material

description: Receive customer shipments, portal monitor and survey, check against the manifest and profile, log containers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Trucks with radioactive waste cannot wait at the gate indefinitely; about 25 inbound shipments per week; receiving errors create manifest discrepancies
manual_workaround: Paper receiving log and container tags; enter into SYS-03 after restoration
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-07 tablets; SYS-09 portal monitor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Waste technicians; health physics technicians; the Plant dock

description: Track every container and source location; sum-of-fractions and possession limit checks; weekly category 2 verification
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: License possession limits and 37.49(a)(3)(ii) weekly verification; an inventory error can cause an unlicensed quantity or a missed category 2 determination
manual_workaround: Printed inventory from the last daily export; physical count; hold new receipts of sources

description: Sorting, supercompaction, shredding, repackaging, and ventilation control
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $113K revenue per business day; storage fills in about 5 days without volume reduction; ventilation must run while waste is open
manual_workaround: Stop open handling; keep exhaust fans in local hand control; store incoming containers unopened
dependent_people_or_facilities: Plant operators; maintenance and controls staff

description: Prepare radioactive, hazardous, and mixed waste shipments; e-Manifest; category 2 license verification and no-later-than coordination
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Manifest and shipment records are regulatory (64E-5.332; 40 CFR 264.71; 37.71 and 37.75); disposal site appointments are booked weeks ahead
manual_workaround: Paper manifests where allowed; postpone category 2 shipments; phone license verification with the issuing authority
dependent_third_parties: EPA e-Manifest; exclusive-use carrier; receiving licensees

description: Schedule and dispatch pickups; field crews at customer sites including 2 reactor sites
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers hold waste on site and have their own storage limits; reactor outage support has fixed windows
manual_workaround: Phone dispatch from printed schedules; paper trip sheets

description: Waste profiles, quotes, pickup requests, certificates of processing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers need certificates for their own license and permit records; profile approval gates every new pickup
manual_workaround: Email and phone; issue certificates after restoration

description: License records, RCRA operating record, training and test records, Part 37 records, State and EPA reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records must be available for inspection and protected from loss (37.101; 40 CFR 264.73-264.74)
manual_workaround: Paper binders for the current quarter

mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $540K billed per week; customers pay on 30-day terms, so short delays cost little
manual_workaround: Queue invoices; manual payments from the bank portal

business_process: HR, payroll, and access authorization records
description: Payroll, onboarding, terminations, background investigation files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; background files are needed only for new approvals and inspections
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the provider; paper background files in the locked cabinet
